entrypoints.description: ArchivedEvidenceRecorder owns fail-closed locator/value verification against immutable artifacts.

extension_seams: Add a generic parser/artifact grounding mode when a new media type cannot be truthfully represented by existing locators.
Add claim_context annotations without silently promoting them into Reality/Judgment.

guards.description: Grounding tests exercise archived excerpt/artifact boundaries.

non_goals: Media-type shortcuts that pretend structured/binary sources are plain text.
purpose: Own verification that a claim-scoped EvidenceFragment is exactly grounded in archived text/PDF/HTML/structured JSON artifacts before any epistemic promotion.
revisit_when: Only replace if the successor preserves claim-scoped immutable artifact lineage, exact locator semantics and fail-closed verification across supported media.
title: Claim-scoped Grounded Evidence
